messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — Galileo confirmed a hardware sweep next week for thermal vs throughput (perf/W). They want kernel-tune results + a short joint summary for marketplace listing. Can we own a minimal plan?

chen: I can own the kernel tuning side. Suggest we standardize on: model=gpt-small-open, seq=1024, batch sizes [1,4,8], power cap sweep [200W, 250W, 300W]. Need firmware image and HF weights path.

sam: infra note: we'll run on Dedicated infra pool (us-west-2-dedicated-3). Need to reserve 6 nodes for 48h to avoid noisy neighbors. Also want telemetry toggled: perf_counters=on, nvml=on.

maria: @sam can you reserve the nodes? @chen can you draft the run script? I'll sync with Galileo on which firmware build. :thumbsup:

garrett: pinged Galileo contact — they sent a test firmware tag: galileo-fw-2026-03-12.gal. They also have a thermal probe daemon we can enable (galileo-bench-agent).

galileo-bot: firmware tag galileo-fw-2026-03-12 available at https://artifacts.galileo/v/galileo-fw-2026-03-12 (signed). Agent package galileo-bench-agent v0.9.2 attached.

chen: draft run script (quick):

```
# run matrix
MODEL=gpt-small-open
SEQ=1024
BATCHES=(1 4 8)
POWERS=(200 250 300)
for b in "${BATCHES[@]}"; do
  for p in "${POWERS[@]}"; do
    run_bench --model $MODEL --seq $SEQ --batch $b --power-cap $p --telemetry nvml,perf_counters --agent galileo-bench-agent
  done
done
```

chen: also plan to capture: tokens/sec, p99 latency, avg power (W) and energy-per-token. We'll export csv and upload to the shared S3 bucket: s3://redwood-partner-results/galileo/1845123456/

sam: nodes reserved: reserved 6 x A100-style nodes in us-west-2-dedicated-3 from 2026-04-06 02:00 -> 2026-04-08 02:00 UTC. I'll attach the runplaybook and a helper script to pin GPU frequency if needed.

alisa: timeline for partnerships/marketing: can we get a preliminary numbers snapshot by EOD 2026-04-08? We want a 1-slide summary for the cloud marketplace listing and an internal blurb for customer success. Also need a short security checklist for Private customers.

maria: target: run finish by 04-08 morning, analysis + slides by 04-09. If kernel tuning shows >12% perf/W improvement at 250W we prioritize that in the blurb.

chen: noted. I'll iterate on kernel patches during the first run (canary) and then lock config for the sweep run. Please flag if we need regression eval prompts — otherwise basic throughput and perf/W metrics first.

garrett: vendor asks for a short test-plan doc. I'll draft a 1-page doc and share in #docs channel and with Galileo contact.

maria: action items:
- sam: confirm reservation + share access creds (by EOD)
- chen: push run script + initial canary config to s3 path and open PR with kernel flags (by tomorrow)
- garrett: draft test-plan doc (by EOD)
- alisa: reserve marketing slot and security checklist owners (by EOD)

maria: anything else? Otherwise I'll schedule a 30m sync for 04-06 10:00 PDT to kickoff. :calendar:

sam: fine with that. I'll post the runplaybook link once I finish access stuff.

chen: will add a short eval harness that runs a small prompt set to check correctness after kernel patches.

alisa: thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll loop in legal if marketplace copy needs approval.

maria: perfect — closing for now, please update thread with links. :rocket:
